C0314.title: DNS DDoS Amplification Attack Detection Using Multi-Layer Perceptron Classification Algorithm
C0314.summary: This 2024 IEEE AIC conference paper studies DNS DDoS amplification attack detection using a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) classification algorithm to analyze network traffic and identify abnormal traffic patterns with machine learning. It focuses on attacks that abuse DNS resolvers to amplify small queries into high-volume traffic and cause denial of service; the source page verifies the paper title, conference, and DOI.
